summary: Advance your career with our 5-day PMER Training. Master Theory of Change, LogFrames, and RBM to drive measurable organizational impact. Enroll today.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who design, manage, monitor, evaluate, or report on programmes and projects. It is particularly relevant when you need to connect implementation evidence with management decisions, funding requirements, organisational learning, and executive reporting.
audience: Programme Directors using evaluation evidence to prioritise
modules: Theory of Change and Programme Planning
Evaluation Design and OECD DAC Criteria
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to programme, project, grants, monitoring, evaluation, reporting, or performance-management work. Familiarity with workplans, budgets, indicators, or routine reporting is recommended. No programming is required. Participants should bring a laptop with spreadsheet capability; access to Power BI and KoboToolbox will depend on the delivery setup, and equivalent templates may be supplied.
